header.title: s500 | Power Pages connected to Azure Storage Container does not display uploaded files

authoredSummary.text:



Collapse
In Power pages site, they have setup Azure Storage Container for file uploads.
The files are being uploaded to the Azure Storage Container successfully. However, when they open a Multistep form that loads the record, the file associated to the record that are stored in Azure Storage Containers are not displaying the filenames and the file size is showing as 0 kb.
I was not able to find any related errors in Kusto Telemetry.
We Reviewed the configuration and everything appears to be correct. Screenshots will be uploaded upon ICM creation
| where portalId == "36f33c1c-5a35-434f-86da-91ff68a5da5e"
| where portalUrl == "https://site-TaxCreditPrograms.powerappsportals.us"
| where org == "4210f923-4cbb-f011-95c8-001dd8025201"
| where tenantId == "a64f12e8-030c-4d02-a5f7-14302e979aac"
| where Tenant == "GCC"
| where portalVersion == "9.8.7.23"
| where portalApp == "s-36f33c1c-5a35-434f-86da-91ff68a5da5e-GCt"

Last updated at 2026-08-25 09:34:05 GMT+5:30
What we know:
A customer reported that a Power Pages site using Azure Storage Container for file uploads successfully stores files, but the associated record view does not show filenames and displays file size as 0 kb. The team reviewed configuration, uploaded a network trace, and checked telemetry and logs, but found no related errors. They also followed the Azure storage enablement documentation and continued reviewing the trace for clues.
Uploaded files are not displaying correctly in the portal form.
Investigation continues after telemetry and configuration checks found no clear error.
What has been done so far:
A network trace was uploaded for analysis.
The team reviewed the portal configuration and found it appeared correct.
Telemetry was checked, but no related errors were found.
The Azure storage enablement documentation was reviewed with the customer.
The trace is being revisited to understand why filenames and file sizes are not rendering correctly.
AI-generated content may be incorrect
